## Setup

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(irr)
library(effectsize)
library(here)
```

```{r import-data}
df_clean <- readRDS(here("Clean Data","df_clean.rds"))
df_y_clean <- readRDS(here("Clean Data","df_y_clean.rds"))
df_c_clean <- readRDS(here("Clean Data","df_c_clean.rds"))
```

## 2. Missingness

### 2.1 Caregiver df missingness

```{r c-missingness}
# List all variables to check missingness
missing_vars <- c(
  "age_cont",
  "adhd_status",
  "gender_c", 
  "pds_total",
  "pubertal_timing",
  "menarche_status",
  "bc_status",
  "bmi",
  "sed_percentile",
  "relationship_c",
  "ethnicity_culture_c",
  "diagnosis_c",
  "adhd_med_status",
  "other_mental_neuro_c",
  "other_health_c",
  "autism",
  "medications_c",
  "ers_total",
  "smfq_total",
  "swan_total"
)

# Function to summarise missingness overall + by ADHD status
summarise_missing <- function(df, var) {
  
  # Overall missingness
  overall <- tibble(
    Variable = var,
    Total_Missing = sum(is.na(df[[var]])),
    Percent_Missing = round(mean(is.na(df[[var]])) * 100, 1)
  )
  
  # Missingness stratified by ADHD status
  by_adhd <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(adhd_status)) %>%
    mutate(adhd_status = factor(adhd_status, levels = c("N", "Y"))) %>%
    group_by(adhd_status, .drop = FALSE) %>%                             
    summarise(
      Total_Missing = sum(is.na(.data[[var]])),
      Percent_Missing = round(mean(is.na(.data[[var]])) * 100, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = adhd_status,
      values_from = c(Total_Missing, Percent_Missing),
      names_glue = "{.value}_{adhd_status}"
    )
  
  # Safety net: fill in any expected columns that still don't exist
  expected_cols <- c("Total_Missing_N", "Percent_Missing_N",
                      "Total_Missing_Y", "Percent_Missing_Y")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(expected_cols, names(by_adhd))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    by_adhd[missing_cols] <- NA
  }
  
  bind_cols(overall, by_adhd)
}

# Apply function to all variables
missing_summary_c <- lapply(missing_vars, function(v) summarise_missing(df_c_clean, v)) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Reorder columns for readability
missing_summary_c <- missing_summary_c %>%
  select(
    Variable,
    Total_Missing, Percent_Missing,
    Total_Missing_N, Percent_Missing_N,
    Total_Missing_Y, Percent_Missing_Y
  )

# Restrict to post-menarche participants for menarche_timing
post_menarche_only <- df_c_clean %>%
  filter(menarche_status == "Y")

# Run the same function on the post-menarche subset
menarche_timing_summary <- summarise_missing(post_menarche_only, "menarche_timing") %>%
  select(
    Variable,
    Total_Missing, Percent_Missing,
    Total_Missing_N, Percent_Missing_N,
    Total_Missing_Y, Percent_Missing_Y
  )

# Append the menarche row to the main table
missing_summary_c <- bind_rows(missing_summary_c, menarche_timing_summary)

print(missing_summary_c, n = Inf)

# Export
write_csv(missing_summary_c, here("Descriptives", "missingness_table_c.csv"))
```

```{r y-missingness}
# Function to summarise missingness overall + by ADHD status
summarise_missing_y <- function(df, var) {
  
  # Overall missingness
  overall <- tibble(
    Variable = var,
    Total_Missing = sum(is.na(df[[var]])),
    Percent_Missing = round(mean(is.na(df[[var]])) * 100, 1)
  )
  
  # Missingness stratified by ADHD status
  by_adhd <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(adhd_y)) %>%
    mutate(adhd_y = factor(adhd_y, levels = c("N", "Y"))) %>%  
    group_by(adhd_y, .drop = FALSE) %>%                        
    summarise(
      Total_Missing = sum(is.na(.data[[var]])),
      Percent_Missing = round(mean(is.na(.data[[var]])) * 100, 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = adhd_y,
      values_from = c(Total_Missing, Percent_Missing),

  # Safety net: fill in any columns still missing (e.g. if a group has 0 rows entirely)
  expected_cols <- c("Total_Missing_N", "Percent_Missing_N",
                     "Total_Missing_Y", "Percent_Missing_Y")
  missing_cols <- setdiff(expected_cols, names(by_adhd))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    by_adhd[missing_cols] <- NA
  }
  
  bind_cols(overall, by_adhd)
}
```

## 3. Distributions 

### 3.1 Histograms whole sample

```{r histograms-whole-sample}
continuous_vars_hist_c <- c(
  "age_cont", "bmi", "sed_percentile", "pds_total", "pubertal_timing",
  "menarche_timing", "ers_total", "smfq_total", "swan_total"
)

continuous_vars_hist_y <- c(
  "age_cont_y", "pds_total_y", "pubertal_timing_y",
  "menarche_timing_y", "ers_total_y", "smfq_total_y"
)

# Helper: one histogram per variable, optionally filled by a grouping variable
plot_histograms <- function(df, vars, group_var = NULL, subtitle = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(group_var)) {
    df <- df %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[group_var]])) %>%
      mutate(group = factor(.data[[group_var]],
                            levels = c("N", "Y"),
                            labels = c("Non-ADHD", "ADHD")))
  }
  
  for (var in vars) {
    
    if (!(var %in% names(df))) {
      warning(var, " not found in data frame, skipping.", call. = FALSE)
      next
    }
    
    n_obs <- sum(!is.na(df[[var]]))
    
    if (is.null(group_var)) {
      p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[var]])) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 10, color = "black", alpha = 0.6)
    } else {
      p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[var]], fill = group)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 10, color = "black", alpha = 0.6,
                       position = "identity") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("Non-ADHD" = "#1f78b4", "ADHD" = "#e31a1c")) +
        labs(fill = "ADHD status")
    }
    
    p <- p +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        x = var,
        y = "Count",
        title = paste("Histogram of", var),
        subtitle = paste0(subtitle, " (n = ", n_obs, ")")
      )
    
    print(p)
  }
}

# Caregiver report
plot_histograms(df_c_clean, continuous_vars_hist_c, subtitle = "Caregiver sample")

# Young person report
plot_histograms(df_y_clean, continuous_vars_hist_y, subtitle = "Young person sample")
```

### 3.2 Histograms by ADHD status

```{r histograms-by-adhd}
plot_hist_by_adhd <- function(df, vars, adhd_var, label) {

  # Convert ADHD to factor
  df_plot <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[adhd_var]])) %>%
    mutate(adhd_group = factor(.data[[adhd_var]],
                               levels = c("N", "Y"),
                               labels = c("Non-ADHD", "ADHD")))

  for (var in vars) {

    if (!(var %in% names(df_plot))) {
      warning(var, " not found in data frame, skipping.", call. = FALSE)
      next
    }

    # n per group, shown in the subtitle
    n_by_group <- df_plot %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
      count(adhd_group, .drop = FALSE)
    n_label <- paste0(n_by_group$adhd_group, " n = ", n_by_group$n, collapse = ", ")

    p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = .data[[var]], fill = adhd_group)) +
      geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", bins = 10, color = "black") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c("Non-ADHD" = "#1f78b4", "ADHD" = "#e31a1c")) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(
        x = var,
        y = "Count",
        fill = "ADHD Status",
        title = paste("Histogram of", var, "by ADHD status"),
        subtitle = paste0(label, " (", n_label, ")")
      )

    print(p)
  }
}

# Caregiver report, split by caregiver-reported ADHD
plot_hist_by_adhd(df_c_clean, continuous_vars_hist_c,
                  adhd_var = "adhd_status", label = "Caregiver sample")

# Young person report, split by young person-reported ADHD
plot_hist_by_adhd(df_y_clean, continuous_vars_hist_y,
                  adhd_var = "adhd_y", label = "Young person sample")
```

## 4. Descriptives tables

### 4.1 Caregiver continuous variables descriptives

```{r c-cont-descriptives}
continuous_vars_c <- c(
  "age_cont",
  "bmi",
  "sed_percentile",
  "pds_total",
  "pubertal_timing",
  "menarche_timing",
  "ers_total",
  "smfq_total",
  "swan_total"
)

# Function to summarise a variable
summarise_cont <- function(df, var) {
  x <- df[[var]]
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  
  if(length(x) == 0) {
    tibble(
      N = 0,
      Range = NA_character_,
      Mean_SD = NA_character_
    )
  } else {
    tibble(
      N = length(x),
      Range = paste0(round(min(x), 2), "–", round(max(x), 2)),
      Mean_SD = paste0(round(mean(x), 2), " (", round(sd(x), 2), ")")
    )
  }
}

# Build table for full sample, non-ADHD, and ADHD
continuous_table <- lapply(continuous_vars_c, function(var) {
  full     <- summarise_cont(df_c_clean, var)
  non_adhd <- summarise_cont(df_c_clean %>% filter(adhd_status == "N"), var)
  adhd     <- summarise_cont(df_c_clean %>% filter(adhd_status == "Y"), var)
  
  tibble(
    Variable = var,
    N_full = full$N,
    Range_full = full$Range, Mean_SD_full = full$Mean_SD,
    N_nonADHD = non_adhd$N,
    Range_nonADHD = non_adhd$Range, Mean_SD_nonADHD = non_adhd$Mean_SD,
    N_ADHD = adhd$N,
    Range_ADHD = adhd$Range, Mean_SD_ADHD = adhd$Mean_SD
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Welch tests table (all differences are ADHD minus Non-ADHD)
welch_tests <- lapply(continuous_vars_c, function(var) {
  
  # Filter once: single source of truth for both tests below
  df_var <- df_c_clean %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(adhd_status)) %>%
    transmute(
      value = .data[[var]],
      group = factor(adhd_status, levels = c("Y", "N"))  # ADHD first
    )
  
  # Need at least 2 observations in each group
  if (any(table(df_var$group) < 2)) {
    return(tibble(Variable = var, n = nrow(df_var)))
  }
  
  t_test <- t.test(value ~ group, data = df_var, var.equal = FALSE)
  d_result <- cohens_d(value ~ group, data = df_var, pooled_sd = TRUE)
  
  tibble(
    Variable  = var,
    n         = nrow(df_var),
    t         = unname(t_test$statistic),
    df        = unname(t_test$parameter),
    p_value   = t_test$p.value,
    mean_diff = unname(t_test$estimate[1] - t_test$estimate[2]),
    diff_lower = t_test$conf.int[1],
    diff_upper = t_test$conf.int[2],
    cohens_d  = d_result$Cohens_d,
    d_lower   = d_result$CI_low,
    d_upper   = d_result$CI_high
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Helper to format p-values APA style
format_p <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p)  ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ "< .001",
    TRUE      ~ sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p))
  )
}

welch_tests <- welch_tests %>%
  mutate(
    p_raw      = p_value,
    p_fmt      = format_p(p_value),
    t          = round(t, 2),
    df         = round(df, 1),
    mean_diff  = round(mean_diff, 2),
    diff_lower = round(diff_lower, 2),
    diff_upper = round(diff_upper, 2),
    cohens_d   = round(cohens_d, 2),
    d_lower    = round(d_lower, 2),
    d_upper    = round(d_upper, 2),
    # Combined strings for a publication-style table
    Mean_diff_CI = paste0(mean_diff, " [", diff_lower, ", ", diff_upper, "]"),
    d_CI         = paste0(cohens_d, " [", d_lower, ", ", d_upper, "]"),
    Welch_t      = paste0("t(", df, ") = ", t)
  )

welch_tests

# Join the two tables
continuous_table_full <- continuous_table %>%
  left_join(welch_tests, by = "Variable") %>%
  select(Variable,
         N_full, Range_full, Mean_SD_full,
         N_nonADHD, Range_nonADHD, Mean_SD_nonADHD,
         N_ADHD, Range_ADHD, Mean_SD_ADHD,
         Welch_t, p = p_fmt, p_raw,
         Mean_diff_CI, d_CI)

# head table
head(continuous_table_full)

# Export
write_csv(continuous_table_full, here("Descriptives", "continuous_table_with_welch.csv"))
```

### 4.3 Caregiver categorical variables descriptives

```{r c-cat-vars-descriptives}
var_levels <- list(
  gender_c = c("girl", "boy", "trans_diverse", "non_binary", "prefer_not", "self_describe"),
  
  ethnicity_culture_c = c("aboriginal_tsi", "anglo_euro", "e_se_sian", "s_asian_middle_eastern", 
                          "ss_african", "multiple", "other"),
  
  relationship_c = c("mother_stepmother", "father_stepfather", "grandparent", "other_relative", 
                     "foster_carer", "legal_guardian_non_relative", "other"),
  
  diagnosis_c = c("paed_psychiatrist", "psychologist", "self_identified", "suspected", "other"),
  
  menarche_status = c("N", "Y"),
  other_mental_neuro_c = c("N", "Y"),
  autism = c("N", "Y"),
  other_health_c = c("N", "Y"),
  adhd_med_status = c("N", "Y"),
  bc_status = c("N", "Y"),
  medications_c = c("N", "Y")
)

# Safety check: make sure no real values would be converted to NA
check_levels <- function(df, levels_list) {
  
  problems <- lapply(names(levels_list), function(var) {
    
    if (!(var %in% names(df))) {
      return(tibble(Variable = var, Unexpected_value = "<column not found>", n = NA_integer_))
    }
    
    observed <- as.character(df[[var]])
    bad <- observed[!is.na(observed) & !(observed %in% levels_list[[var]])]
    
    if (length(bad) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    tibble(Variable = var, Unexpected_value = bad) %>%
      count(Variable, Unexpected_value)
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  if (nrow(problems) > 0) {
    print(problems, n = Inf)
    stop("Some values in the data are not in the expected levels and would be ",
         "converted to NA. Fix the data or update the levels list (see table above).",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  
  message("Level check passed: all non-missing values match the expected levels.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

check_levels(df_c_clean, var_levels)

categorical_vars <- names(var_levels)

categorical_table <- lapply(categorical_vars, function(var) {
  
  if (!(var %in% names(df_c_clean))) return(NULL)
  
  lv <- var_levels[[var]]

  # "Missing" becomes an explicit level, so it is counted and gets a percentage.
  # check_levels() has already run, so any NA here is a genuine missing value.
  x <- df_c_clean %>%
    mutate(
      Level = factor(replace_na(as.character(.data[[var]]), "Missing"),
                     levels = c(lv, "Missing")),
      adhd_status = factor(adhd_status, levels = c("N", "Y"))
    )

  # Full sample (percentages out of total sample, including missing)
  full_df <- x %>%
    count(Level, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      Perc_full = if (sum(n) == 0) 0 else round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
      Full = paste0(n, " (", Perc_full, "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(Level, Full)

  # ADHD split (percentages out of each ADHD group's total, including missing)
  adhd_df <- x %>%
    filter(!is.na(adhd_status)) %>%
    count(adhd_status, Level, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(adhd_status) %>%
    mutate(
      Perc  = if (sum(n) == 0) 0 else round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
      Value = paste0(n, " (", Perc, "%)")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Level, adhd_status, Value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = adhd_status, values_from = Value,
                values_fill = "0 (0%)")

  # Safety net: ensure both N and Y columns exist
  for (col in setdiff(c("N", "Y"), names(adhd_df))) adhd_df[[col]] <- "0 (0%)"

  # Return value (levels stay in the order of var_levels, with Missing last)
  full_df %>%
    left_join(adhd_df, by = "Level") %>%
    mutate(Variable = var, Level = as.character(Level)) %>%
    select(Variable, Level, Full, N, Y)
  
}) %>% bind_rows()

head(categorical_table)

write_csv(categorical_table, here("Descriptives", "descriptives_categorical.csv"))
```

### 4.4 Caregiver categorical group differences

```{r c-cat-group-diffs}
# Helper to format p-values
format_p <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    is.na(p)  ~ NA_character_,
    p < 0.001 ~ "< .001",
    TRUE      ~ sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p))
  )
}

categorical_tests <- lapply(categorical_vars, function(var) {

  empty_row <- function(test_label) {
    tibble(Variable = var, Test = test_label, n = NA_integer_,
           Statistic = NA_real_, df = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
           Cramers_V = NA_real_)
  }

  if (!(var %in% names(df_c_clean))) return(empty_row("Column not found"))

  df_test <- df_c_clean %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]]), !is.na(adhd_status)) %>%
    select(adhd_status, all_of(var))

  tab <- table(df_test$adhd_status, df_test[[var]])

  # Drop empty rows/columns (e.g. unused factor levels)
  tab <- tab[rowSums(tab) > 0, colSums(tab) > 0, drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(tab) < 2 || ncol(tab) < 2) return(empty_row("Not testable"))

  tryCatch({
    n_total  <- sum(tab)
    expected <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)$expected)

    # 2x2: Fisher if any expected < 5
    # Larger tables: Fisher if any expected < 1 or > 20% of cells < 5 (Cochran's rule)
    use_fisher <- if (nrow(tab) == 2 && ncol(tab) == 2) {
      any(expected < 5)
    } else {
      any(expected < 1) || mean(expected < 5) > 0.2
    }

    # Cramer's V from the uncorrected chi-squared statistic
    chisq_stat <- unname(suppressWarnings(chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)$statistic))
    cramers_v  <- sqrt(chisq_stat / (n_total * (min(nrow(tab), ncol(tab)) - 1)))

    if (use_fisher) {
      # Exact test; fall back to a simulated p-value if the workspace is too small
      fisher_label <- "Fisher's exact"
      test <- tryCatch(
        fisher.test(tab, workspace = 2e7),
        error = function(e) {
          fisher_label <<- "Fisher's exact (simulated p)"
          set.seed(123)
          fisher.test(tab, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e5)
        }
      )
      tibble(Variable = var, Test = fisher_label, n = n_total,
             Statistic = NA_real_, df = NA_real_,
             p_value = test$p.value, Cramers_V = round(cramers_v, 2))
    } else {
      test <- chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)
      tibble(Variable = var, Test = "Chi-squared", n = n_total,
             Statistic = round(unname(test$statistic), 2),
             df = unname(test$parameter),
             p_value = test$p.value, Cramers_V = round(cramers_v, 2))
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(sprintf("%s: test failed with error \"%s\" — check this variable's table manually.",
                    var, conditionMessage(e)), call. = FALSE)
    empty_row("Error")
  })
}) %>% bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    p_raw = p_value,
    p     = format_p(p_value)
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, Test, n, Statistic, df, p, Cramers_V, p_raw)

categorical_tests
```

```{r y-cat-vars-descriptives}
var_levels_y <- list(
  gender_y = c("girl", "boy", "trans_diverse", "non_binary", "prefer_not", "self_describe"),
  menarche_status_y = c("N", "Y"),
  bc_status_y = c("N", "Y")
)

# Safety check: make sure no real values would be converted to NA
check_levels <- function(df, levels_list) {
  
  problems <- lapply(names(levels_list), function(var) {
    
    if (!(var %in% names(df))) {
      return(tibble(Variable = var, Unexpected_value = "<column not found>", n = NA_integer_))
    }
    
    observed <- as.character(df[[var]])
    bad <- observed[!is.na(observed) & !(observed %in% levels_list[[var]])]
    
    if (length(bad) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    tibble(Variable = var, Unexpected_value = bad) %>%
      count(Variable, Unexpected_value)
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  
  if (nrow(problems) > 0) {
    print(problems, n = Inf)
    stop("Some values in the data are not in the expected levels and would be ",
         "converted to NA. Fix the data or update the levels list (see table above).",
         call. = FALSE)
  }
  
  message("Level check passed: all non-missing values match the expected levels.")
  invisible(TRUE)
}

check_levels(df_y_clean, var_levels_y)

categorical_vars_y <- names(var_levels_y)

categorical_table_y <- lapply(categorical_vars_y, function(var) {
  
  if (!(var %in% names(df_y_clean))) return(NULL)
  
  lv <- var_levels_y[[var]]

  # "Missing" becomes an explicit level, so it is counted and gets a percentage.
  # check_levels() has already run, so any NA here is a genuine missing value.
  x <- df_y_clean %>%
    mutate(
      Level = factor(replace_na(as.character(.data[[var]]), "Missing"),
                     levels = c(lv, "Missing")),
      adhd_y = factor(adhd_y, levels = c("N", "Y"))
    )

  # Full sample (percentages out of total sample, including missing)
  full_df_y <- x %>%
    count(Level, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(
      Perc_full = if (sum(n) == 0) 0 else round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
      Full = paste0(n, " (", Perc_full, "%)")
    ) %>%
    select(Level, Full)

  # ADHD split (percentages out of each ADHD group's total, including missing)
  adhd_df_y <- x %>%
    filter(!is.na(adhd_y)) %>%
    count(adhd_y, Level, .drop = FALSE) %>%
    group_by(adhd_y) %>%
    mutate(
      Perc  = if (sum(n) == 0) 0 else round(100 * n / sum(n), 1),
      Value = paste0(n, " (", Perc, "%)")
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Level, adhd_y, Value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = adhd_y, values_from = Value,
                values_fill = "0 (0%)")

  # Safety net: ensure both N and Y columns exist
  for (col in setdiff(c("N", "Y"), names(adhd_df_y))) adhd_df_y[[col]] <- "0 (0%)"

  # Return value (levels stay in the order of var_levels_y, with Missing last)
  full_df_y %>%
    left_join(adhd_df_y, by = "Level") %>%
    mutate(Variable = var, Level = as.character(Level)) %>%
    select(Variable, Level, Full, N, Y)
  
}) %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r informant-agreement}
# Cohen's kappa for binary variables
kappa_pairs <- list(
  menarche_status = c("menarche_status", "menarche_status_y"),
  adhd_status     = c("adhd_c", "adhd_y")
)

kappa_results <- lapply(names(kappa_pairs), function(name) {
  vars <- kappa_pairs[[name]]
  
  if (!all(vars %in% names(df_clean))) {
    warning(name, ": column(s) not found: ",
            paste(setdiff(vars, names(df_clean)), collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df_pair <- df_clean %>%
    select(all_of(vars)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  # Force identical levels so kappa isn't thrown off by a missing category
  lv <- c("N", "Y")
  df_pair[] <- lapply(df_pair, factor, levels = lv)
  
  k <- kappa2(df_pair)
  
  tibble(
    Variable = name,
    n        = k$subjects,
    Kappa    = round(k$value, 2),
    z        = round(k$statistic, 2),
    p_value  = signif(k$p.value, 3)
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

kappa_results

    return(NULL)
  }
  
  df_pair <- df_clean %>%
    select(all_of(vars)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  if (nrow(df_pair) < 3) {
    return(tibble(Variable = name, n = nrow(df_pair), ICC = NA_real_,
                  CI_lower = NA_real_, CI_upper = NA_real_,
                  F = NA_real_, df1 = NA_real_, df2 = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_))
  }
  
  # ICC(A,1): two-way, absolute agreement, single rater
  res <- icc(df_pair, model = "twoway", type = "agreement", unit = "single")
  
  tibble(
    Variable = name,
    n        = res$subjects,
    ICC      = round(res$value, 2),
    CI_lower = round(res$lbound, 2),
    CI_upper = round(res$ubound, 2),
    F        = round(res$Fvalue, 2),
    df1      = res$df1,
    df2      = round(res$df2, 1),
    p_value  = signif(res$p.value, 3)
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()
```

### 5.2 Within-sample internal consistency

```{r internal-consistency}
# Pull items by name
get_items <- function(df, prefix, n_items) {
  item_names <- paste0(prefix, "_", seq_len(n_items))
  absent <- setdiff(item_names, names(df))
  if (length(absent) > 0) stop("Items not found: ", paste(absent, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  items <- select(df, all_of(item_names))
  if (!all(sapply(items, is.numeric))) stop(prefix, ": non-numeric items, recode first", call. = FALSE)
  items
}

add_note <- function(old, new) paste(na.omit(c(old, new)), collapse = "; ")

# Standardised alpha + one-factor omega total from a FIML correlation matrix
reliability <- function(df, prefix, n_items, title) {
  
  items <- get_items(df, prefix, n_items)
  
  items <- items[rowSums(!is.na(items)) / n_items >= 0.8, ]
  
  res <- tibble(Scale = title, n_items = n_items,
                n_obs = nrow(items),
                alpha_std = NA_real_, omega_total = NA_real_, note = NA_character_)
  
  tryCatch({
    r <- suppressWarnings(corFiml(items))
    
    # Smooth if not positive definite
    if (min(eigen(r, only.values = TRUE)$values) <= 1e-8) {
      r <- psych::cor.smooth(r)
      res$note <- add_note(res$note, "FIML matrix smoothed")
    }
    
    # Standardised alpha from the mean inter-item correlation
    rbar <- mean(r[lower.tri(r)])
    res$alpha_std <- n_items * rbar / (1 + (n_items - 1) * rbar)
    
    # One-factor model: capture warnings instead of suppressing them
    fa_warnings <- character()
    f <- withCallingHandlers(
      psych::fa(r, nfactors = 1, fm = "minres"),
      warning = function(w) {
        fa_warnings <<- c(fa_warnings, conditionMessage(w))
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      }
    )
    
    lam <- as.numeric(f$loadings)
    if (sum(lam) < 0) lam <- -lam
    h2  <- as.numeric(f$communality)
    
    res$omega_total <- sum(lam)^2 / (sum(lam)^2 + sum(1 - lam^2))
    
    # Flags
    if (any(lam < 0)) {
      res$note <- add_note(res$note, "mixed-sign loadings: check reverse-coding")
    }
    if (any(grepl("Heywood", fa_warnings, ignore.case = TRUE)) ||
        any(h2 >= 0.99) || any(abs(lam) >= 0.99)) {
      res$note <- add_note(res$note, "Heywood case / loading at boundary: omega unreliable")
    }
    other_w <- fa_warnings[!grepl("Heywood", fa_warnings, ignore.case = TRUE)]
    if (length(other_w) > 0) {
      res$note <- add_note(res$note, paste("fa warning:", paste(unique(other_w), collapse = " | ")))
    }
    if (res$omega_total >= 1) {
      res$note <- add_note(res$note, "omega >= 1: impossible value")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    res$note <<- add_note(res$note, paste("failed:", conditionMessage(e)))
  })
  
  res
}

scales <- tribble(
  ~prefix,   ~n_items, ~title,
  "pds_c",    5,       "Caregiver PDS",
  "pds_y",    5,       "Young Person PDS",
  "ers_c",    21,      "Caregiver ERS",
  "ers_y",    21,      "Young Person ERS",
  "smfq_c",   13,      "Caregiver SMFQ",
  "smfq_y",   13,      "Young Person SMFQ",
  "swan_c",   18,      "Caregiver SWAN"
)

omega_results <- scales %>%
  pmap(function(prefix, n_items, title) reliability(df_clean, prefix, n_items, title)) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(across(c(alpha_std, omega_total), ~ round(., 2)))

print(omega_results, width = Inf)

write_csv(omega_results, here("Descriptives", "internal_consistency.csv"))
```
